inputs.body:
Hi there. We had the sump pump put in two years ago and I never asked about upkeep. How often should it be checked and is that something you can do? We get a lot of rain in the fall.

Thanks, Jerome

I don't have a confirmed answer on how often your sump pump should be serviced, or whether we can do that service, so I'm passing your question to the team and someone will follow up with you. If you'd like to talk sooner, you can reach the office at 555-0142.

Best regards,
Brightwater Home Services","facts_used":["Annual maintenance plan: $199 per year","Office phone: 555-0142"]}
